main.description: One event in a publisher's stream. Events in a stream form a chain: each one after the first names the CID of the one before it. Record key: <stream>-<12-digit seq>, such as releases-000000000042.

stream.description: Stream name: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters and digits.

seq.description: Position in the stream. The first event is 1, and each event is one more than the last.

prevEventCid.description: CID of the event record at seq - 1. Required for every event after the first, and absent on the first.

kind.description: What the event does. A correction or withdrawal is a new event that points at an earlier one; published events are never edited or deleted.

refSeq.description: For kind correct or withdraw: the seq of the earlier event this one corrects or withdraws.
